summary: wait_for can check several command results by index; each condition starts with result[N] where N is the command's position.
questions: How do I check multiple commands' output with wait_for?
What does result[1] mean in wait_for?

answer_card.title: wait_for with multiple commands
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- arista.eos.eos_command:
    commands:
      - show interface Ethernet4 | json
      - show interface Ethernet5 | json
    wait_for:
      - "result[0].interfaces.Ethernet4.interfaceStatus eq connected"
      - "result[1].interfaces.Ethernet5.interfaceStatus eq connected"
```
Always start with `result[N]`, where N is the command's index (0 = first).
